design.external_chain: UP and DOWN SDA/SCL tied directly to COMMON_A bus. Private SIDE_B to ESP32 GPIO8SDA/GPIO9SCL.
design.enable: PG_RESET_N; rail transitions may truncate transactions; firmware must recover bus.
design.pullups: PrivateB eachboard4.7k tolocal3.3V. CommonA oneenabled2.2k pair usingJP2(master); avoidparallel32pairs.
design.powered_off: A/B pins high impedance when unpowered; sharedA copper maintains chain continuity.
design.forbidden: Do not join B pins of multiple buffers.
design.logic_margin: BufferedB LOW max0.6V <ESP32VIL0.825V at3.3V; external sender onB must pullLOW<=0.4V duringcontention. ValidateGPIO8/9 sinkunder~0.7mA overtemperature.
